howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Convert
howto.text: Click Convert. Every page is rendered in color at 200 DPI; there is no resolution setting on this page.

howto.name: Download the TIFF
howto.text: PrivaTools produces a single multi-page TIFF with one image per PDF page, compressed losslessly with Deflate.

faq.a: TIFF supports lossless compression (LZW, Deflate) and is the format of choice for long-term preservation in libraries and government archives.

faq.q: Single multi-page TIFF or one per page?
faq.a: Always one multi-page TIFF; there is no per-page option. If your software only reads single-page TIFFs, split the PDF into one file per page with Split PDF and convert those files together: each gives a single-page TIFF.
TIFF is raster only — the text layer is lost, so the pages cannot be searched. Keep the original PDF alongside the TIFF if you need searchable text.
